info.title: FastOCR API: Document OCR
info.description:
Asynchronous REST API for document OCR. Upload a PDF, and get the extracted text or a searchable PDF back, across 100+ languages. The v1 document API accepts PDF files only, up to 1 GiB.

Flow: POST /v1/documents (create the job and get a presigned upload URL), PUT the PDF to that URL, POST /v1/documents/{documentId}/start, poll GET /v1/documents/{documentId} until the status is completed, partial, or failed, then GET /v1/documents/{documentId}/output?format=text|pdf for a short-lived download link.

Access: API access is granted per account on request (private beta). Email support@fastocr.org from your FastOCR account email to ask for it. An approved account creates API keys at https://fastocr.org/developers/keys and gets 10 free document pages per month. An approved account buys more pages by card at https://fastocr.org/developers/keys (prepaid API page packs).

Errors: request errors return the error envelope {"error": {type, code, message, request_id}}. Branch on code, never on message, and treat an unknown code as new behavior. A job that fails during processing is not an HTTP error: GET returns 200 with status failed and an error object. Errors generated by the API gateway before a request reaches the API (401 missing Authorization header, 403 unknown, malformed, or revoked key, 429 above the gateway request throttle) have the body {"message": "..."} and, on newer deployments, an additional error object with type gateway_error (see GatewayError). If the error object is absent, rely on the HTTP status and message. Back off and retry on 429.

Concurrency: by default an account can have 2 documents processing at once. Accounts with a prepaid API page allowance or API page credits can have 10. A start request over the limit returns 429 concurrency_limit with a Retry-After header.

Versioning and compatibility: /v1 is additive-only. Fields are added, never renamed, removed, or retyped; status codes and existing error codes do not change. New fields, new statuses, and new error codes may appear: clients must ignore unknown fields and treat an unknown error code as processing_failed (job errors) or by its HTTP status (request errors). Anything breaking would ship as /v2 with at least 6 months of /v1 overlap.

post.description: Create a job for a PDF and receive a presigned upload URL. PUT the file to upload_url with Content-Type: application/pdf within one hour, then call the start endpoint. The upload must be exactly size_bytes long or start returns 400 size_mismatch.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value for this create request, such as a UUID. Repeating a request with the same key and the same body within about 24 hours returns the original 201 response, including the original job id and upload_url. Reusing the key with a different body returns 409 idempotency_key_conflict. The body is compared on filename, size_bytes, sha256, and external_id. The header name is matched case-insensitively.

201.description: Job created. The first request and any idempotent replay both return 201.

400.description: The request is invalid. error.code is one of: invalid_json (body is not valid JSON or is not a JSON object), missing_idempotency_key (no Idempotency-Key header), invalid_filename (filename is missing or not a string), unsupported_file_type (filename does not end in .pdf), invalid_size_bytes (size_bytes is not a positive integer), file_too_large (size_bytes is over 1,073,741,824). error.type is invalid_request.

401.description: No Authorization header. Returned by the gateway before the request reaches the API. The body has message and, on newer deployments, an error object with code unauthorized; if error is absent, rely on the HTTP status and message.

403.description: The Authorization header is present but the key is unknown, malformed, or revoked. Returned by the gateway with HTTP 403, not 401. The body has message and, on newer deployments, an error object with code access_denied; if error is absent, rely on the HTTP status and message. The message text is generated by the gateway and can change. A key that was revoked in the last 60 seconds can still be accepted because the gateway caches key checks for up to 60 seconds. A request to a route that does not exist also returns 403, with code missing_authentication_token.

429.description: The request was above the gateway request throttle. Returned by the gateway with code throttled; the body has message and, on newer deployments, an error object. Back off and retry.

500.description: Unexpected server error. error.type is error and error.code is not a stable value; treat any 5xx as retryable with backoff.

get.description: List the account's document jobs, newest created first. Filters are applied after a page of jobs is read, so a page can hold fewer than limit items, or none, while next_cursor is still set. Keep following next_cursor until it is null.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs to read for this page, from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's next_cursor. A cursor expires 24 hours after it is issued; an expired or malformed cursor returns 400 invalid_cursor.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Return only jobs with this public status. Any other value returns 400 invalid_status.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Return jobs whose last status change, or creation time if the status never changed, is at or after this value. The value is compared as text against timestamps stored in UTC ISO 8601 form such as 2026-10-01T12:34:56.789012+00:00, and it is never rejected. Send a UTC timestamp with a +00:00 offset, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00, or a date such as 2026-10-01, and percent-encode the + as %2B in the query string. A value ending in Z sorts after the same instant written with +00:00, so it skips jobs changed in that same second. A non-UTC offset gives wrong results.

400.description: The query is invalid. error.code is one of: invalid_limit (limit is not an integer from 1 to 100), invalid_status (status is not a public status), invalid_cursor (cursor is malformed or older than 24 hours). error.type is invalid_request.

delete.description: Request deletion of the job and its files. The files and the job record are removed in the background. GET never returns a deleting status: until the record is gone the job keeps its last status, and after that GET and DELETE return 404 document_not_found. Repeating the request while deletion is pending returns 202 again.

post.description: Start OCR after the PDF is uploaded. No request body. Calling it for any document that is already in flight (processing, or in its final steps) returns 202 with status processing. A job that failed with error.code buy_pages can be started again after FastOCR adds pages to the account. Page usage is reserved once the real page count is known, after this call returns.

parameters.description: Document ID returned by the create request.

error.message: Document cannot be started from its current state

429.description: Two different 429 responses are possible. (1) The handler's concurrency_limit: too many of the account's documents are processing; the body is the ErrorResponse envelope with error.type rate_limit, the Retry-After header is present, and the job stays awaiting_upload, so call start again after the delay. (2) The gateway's throttled: the request was above the gateway request throttle; the body is the GatewayError shape and there is no Retry-After header, so back off and retry.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before calling start again. Always 30. Present only for concurrency_limit, not for the gateway's throttled.

error.message: Too many API documents are processing; retry later

500.description: Unexpected server error. error.type is error and error.code is not a stable value; treat any 5xx as retryable with backoff.

BearerAuth.description: Send an API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Keys start with fok_live_. API access is granted per account on request (private beta). Email support@fastocr.org from your FastOCR account email to ask for it. An approved account creates API keys at https://fastocr.org/developers/keys and gets 10 free document pages per month. An approved account buys more pages by card at https://fastocr.org/developers/keys (prepaid API page packs).

filename.description: The original filename. It must end in .pdf (case-insensitive); other file types return 400 unsupported_file_type.

size_bytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes. The maximum is 1 GiB. Start returns 400 size_mismatch if the uploaded file differs.

sha256.description: Optional. The SHA-256 digest of the file as base64 of the 32 raw digest bytes, the encoding S3 uses for x-amz-checksum-sha256. The API does not validate or convert it; it is attached to the presigned upload URL, so S3 rejects an upload whose content does not match. Hex-encoded digests are not accepted by S3. The value is part of the idempotency body comparison.

external_id.description: Optional value of your own, stored with the job and returned as external_id. Not validated or required to be unique.

upload_url.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL. Send the PDF with Content-Type: application/pdf.

expires_at.description: One hour after the job was created; UTC with a +00:00 offset.

status.description: Only ever returned by DELETE. GET does not return this value.

url.description: Presigned download URL, valid for one hour.

status.description: awaiting_upload: created, not started. processing: running. completed: done. partial: done, but the account's remaining pages covered only the first pages_billed pages of the document (is_truncated is true). failed: see error. There is no deleting status.

pages_billed.description: Pages charged against the account's page allowance. Present once pages are reserved.

pages_total.description: Pages in the uploaded PDF. Present once the page count is known.

is_truncated.description: True when fewer pages were processed than the PDF has. Present once set by processing.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next page. Null when there are no more pages.

type.description: invalid_request (400), not_found (404), conflict (409), rate_limit (429), or error (500). New values may be added.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, see the 4xx responses on each operation. New codes may be added; do not branch on message.

GatewayError.description: Gateway-generated body for 401, 403, and gateway 429 responses. message is always present. error is present on newer deployments; if it is absent, rely on the HTTP status and message. Other properties may appear.

type.description: gateway_error today. New values may be added.

code.description: unauthorized (401), access_denied (403, unknown, malformed, or revoked key), throttled (429), missing_authentication_token (403 on a route that does not exist, only when the request has no Authorization header; the same request with a Bearer key returns 403 gateway_error), or gateway_error for anything else. New codes may be added; handle an unknown code by the HTTP status.

message.description: Same text as the top-level message.

JobError.description: Present when status is failed. Branch on code; new codes may be added, and an unknown code should be handled as processing_failed.

type.description: insufficient_credits, invalid_request, or processing_error. New values may be added.

code.description: buy_pages (the account is out of pages; buy API pages at https://fastocr.org/developers/keys, then call start again on the same job), password_protected, unreadable_document, no_text_detected, corrupted_file, too_many_pages, empty_file, timeout, out_of_memory, or processing_failed.

retryable.description: True for timeout, out_of_memory, and processing_failed.
